observations.note: The active patch remains the exact 80-pixel historical termination support at bounds [727,569,736,589]; it does not invent a full-height panel.
At normal scene scale the return reads as a small countertop termination and does not create a gross detached object or remote scene change.
The same bounded support changes from the neutral stone sample to the selected green stone material while preserving alpha support.
Changing the MDF/front finish after selecting green stone leaves the BMC-02 stone-only return unchanged.

The exact historical 80-pixel geometry has a visibly stepped boundary under strong magnification. At scene scale this is minor; human review should decide whether antialiased coverage is desirable before any default promotion.
No appearance defect currently warrants image generation; if the edge needs refinement, deterministic antialiasing should be tested first.
